content: iOS Web Push: requires iOS/iPadOS 16.4+, PWA installed via Safari Share > Add to Home Screen (standalone), manifest present, permission prompt only from a user gesture. Safari has no beforeinstallprompt, so apps must show their own A2HS instruction UI; Chrome/Edge on iOS cannot install PWAs. Web push unavailable in EU on iOS 17.4+ (not relevant to Brazil). Android Chrome supports beforeinstallprompt and push in-browser.
